text: Use only the SOLIDS FOR YOU tools (github.com/Founderwithabs/SOLIDSFORYOU), routed by Master. Do not use the old claude.ai skills sfy-reel-virality or quell-reel-virality.
Store facts, decisions and preferences in this memory sheet (memory/memory.csv) and look them up here before asking the founder.

New Instagram page about Indian startups for Indian Gen Z 21-30 with money to spend. All videos are motion graphics only (no filming, no clipping), voiced with ElevenLabs. Target: 6 startup videos and 3 Solids For You awareness videos a day. SFY main page comes later.

Draft strategy in social/strategy.md: motion-graphics videos built with the Master video workflow, one template per series, start at 3 a day and work up to 9, bio says who runs the page, every startup number sourced.
Get Solids For You product facts from the founder (products, prices, sizes, claims allowed) and add them here before writing any SFY reel.
Instagram API client code is in sfy_instagram/ (README.md explains it); merged into the review branch, which goes to main through one pull request.

Motion graphics style from founder's references (Drive folder 1euircKI12rys5i2cVhhleaOED1AuEsKt): dark near-black backgrounds with one glowing accent colour (teal, amber or purple), kinetic text that types in and highlights one key word, glass UI cards and app icons, glowing rings and light flares, clean sans-serif, logo reveal on a glowing horizon at the end. Fifth reference (Spotify-style, uploaded 2026-10-25): soft green glow on black, the brand's own UI pieces (track cards, filter chips, artist circles) as props, a short tagline split over two beats, logo reveal then handle card. Accent colour can follow the featured company's brand colour.
All voice-overs are in Hinglish, made with ElevenLabs by the founder in bulk: one batch of 18 voice-overs covers 2 days (12 startup + 6 SFY videos).
Some videos (Brand Autopsy and 30-Second Founder) use the heavy-animation style of the Spotify-style reference: very animated but beautiful. Others use simpler reusable templates.

Instagram page: Unicorn Ka Hisab, handle @unicornkahisab. Spelling is HISAB (one 'a') everywhere: name, logo, captions. Logo in brand/logo/ (ukh-icon, ukh-wordmark, ukh-stacked). Bio in English, in social/account-setup.md.

Founder prefers horizontal (1920x1080) reels: the reels that match his taste are horizontal. Make new reels horizontal unless told otherwise.

Track is "addiction" by LONOWN and Asenssia (Spotify 57APJu1T2SP0JFR94PKDfu); credit it in captions. Post reels with the founder's chosen music even though it may be copyrighted; founder accepts the risk and removes muted reels himself. Music should fade in or use a riser so it never feels like it starts mid-song.

After the 9 reels of 26 Oct 2026 post, review Instagram insights with the founder (views, watch time, follows), compare vertical Blinkit vs horizontal reels and morning vs evening slots. Founder loved the reels' style.
Founder wants camera movements in reels: 3D push-ins, pans, tilts, orbits per scene and whip-pans on cuts (built into videos/template/reel.html).

Real SFY fabric and workshop footage (10 photos + 18 clips: cutting, stitching, SOLIDS label sheets, heat press, label reveal, drawstrings; blue tees and black joggers) is in Drive folder 1Q3kI0Qqr9yB1W7WPbjOVxVOd-n8cEe8Y; photos in videos/sfy/img, clip cut list in videos/sfy/edit.js (extract.py makes frames). SFY edit: videos/sfy/scene.html (photo-only first version: photos.html) -> public/reels/sfy-fabric-30s.mp4 (no product claims, since SFY facts are still missing).

Use Openverse only for real-life stock photos (videos/stock.py, no key; commercial + modification licences only). Credit the creator in the caption when credits.json says credit_required. Pixabay is set up in the script but not in use.

Reels are hosted from the public repo via raw.githubusercontent.com/solidsforyou/moneymoments-media/<branch>/public/reels/<file>.mp4 (push first). The container proxy blocks that host for curl, but Instagram fetches it fine. Captions must be set at container creation; the API cannot add them later.

No @mentions of brands or @solidsforyou in startup captions: name companies in plain text. Editing a caption with mentions hit Instagram's feedback_required block on 27 Oct (new account, spam signal). Account Status was clear.

Make reels trend-led: tie each one to what Indian startup news is discussing that week (share moves, results, controversies) so it earns likes and shares. Indian D2C brands' current troubles are an approved topic. Run harsh-buyer-review before posting.

Daily mix, 4 reels: 1 Startup ka Hisab (one company's numbers), 1 D2C market news (the sector, not one brand), and 2 Indian economy news reels, one of which can sometimes be a finance tip tied to the news (educational, not personal advice). No international news. No brand-specific D2C reels for now.

Signature for every reel (from founder's reference Video-20093, 27 Oct): one continuous Hisab line (the money trend, amber, never cuts, morphs between scenes) and one amber ₹ coin riding it, landing at the start and rolling into the end card. Built in videos/d2c/scene.html; reuse it. On-screen text mostly English. Use Solids For You footage (assets/sfy/) for positive moments, labelled on screen. Founder loved the D2C reel built this way (27 Oct): treat it as the benchmark.

SFY footage library in git: assets/sfy/clips (label-closeup, stitching-hands, sewing-machine, heat-press-vertical) and assets/sfy/photos (blue tees, black joggers); README there. Originals stay in Drive folder 1Q3kI0Qqr9yB1W7WPbjOVxVOd-n8cEe8Y.
Read every message in full, including every attachment (all photos, videos), and act on all of it; messages sent while a task is running are live instructions to pick up immediately.

Camera rule (founder, 27 Oct): every reel is one continuous camera move. The coin drops in on the first frame; to go to the next screen the coin rolls to the centre and the camera moves right with it into the next panel. The camera never stops and never cuts. Engine: videos/lib/hisab.js (panels side by side in one world).

Reel length: as long as the story needs, no fixed duration; shorter or longer than 60 s is fine (founder, 27 Oct, replaces the ~60 s rule). Pace panels so a viewer can read each one; explain, don't flash numbers. Watch time is not the goal. Set panel lengths from the content first, then fit the music (trim with fade-out or extend), not 12 panels forced onto the 60 s mix. The 27 Oct reels stay as they are.
Less text, more visuals, always (founder, 27 Oct): every word on screen gets a meaningful visual (icon, object, diagram) in the same frame. Short labels, not sentences. Icon set: videos/lib/icons.js.

Founder loved the visual-first reels with the continuous coin camera (27 Oct): D2C, inflation, EMI tip, Swiggy are the style benchmark (not for length, see #26). Approved slots that day: Swiggy 5 pm, D2C 3 pm, inflation 7 pm, EMI tip 9 pm IST.

Captions dropped on API posts after the 26 Oct action block (boAt, Urban Company, D2C, Swiggy, inflation on 27 Oct), pre-made container or not. EMI tip at 9 pm IST 27 Oct (created and published in one go) kept its caption, so the issue may be clearing. Cause unconfirmed. Check every post's caption right after publishing; if missing, give the founder the text to paste.
Anything for print (checklists, box labels, shipment sheets) is black and white only: pure black on white, no greys or colour (founder, 27 Oct). Black logo: assets/brand/sfy-logo-black.png.

Founder is building a brand-new app from scratch (agreed brief v2 in #40 and app-kit/brief.md). Skill development is done: app-kit/ holds the reusable SOLIDS FOR YOU skills, 7 new app skills (app-spec, app-stack, app-build, app-ui-taste, app-testing, app-security, app-release) under a new App head in Master, a starter memory sheet and a reference OAuth/API client. Copy app-kit/ into the app's repo.
Claude is the front-end design lead for the new app until the founder's backend skills are ready.

New app concept: a trust-first social video platform with only verified videos on finance, crypto, stocks, news and international news, built like a normal social network, with a separate trading area inside it. Launch with crypto (through a crypto gateway); stocks later. Every video can cite its sources. Ads nudge users to stop scrolling and invest small amounts (e.g. 100). Pitch: CoinDCX + Instagram news channels + trusted sources, not algorithm-driven.

Still open for the new app: the name, the platform (mobile, web or both), what counts as a verified video (creator KYC, fact-checked content, or both), and which crypto gateway or exchange partner to use.
For the new app: ask the founder questions first and agree what we're making before any mockups, designs or reviews. Ask as many questions as needed.

New app v1 brief agreed and saved in app-kit/brief.md: for everyone, global, iPhone first; approved creators only (unpaid); fully verified (KYC, credentials, AI+human fact-check before live, sources); short and long videos, no lives; crypto only via a gateway partner (front end only); trading fees only; Approve reaction; DMs; rare in-app invest ads; small real launch.

New app brief v2 (replaces #39, see app-kit/brief.md): a trading-first crypto app with a finance social network inside. LinkedIn-serious content, Instagram feel (reels). Opens on the feed, trade one tap away. Anyone posts after a quick check; topic tags; removed on report; no pre-checks. Optional sources and verified badge; Approve kept. Quick profile (name, username, photo, headline, topics), customisable later. Crypto via gateway, fees only.
Idea parked for later: get early content and views through clipping campaigns with a clipping agency. Founder said skip it for now; no details agreed.
New app name: Chartroom. Quick web search on 28 Oct found no app or company with that name (similar: ChartIQ, ChartChamps, Pro Trading Room). Domain, App Store and trademark checks are still to do.
Chartroom look: dark and light modes, dark by default. Optional profile extras: work history (LinkedIn-style) and links to other socials only; no holdings or trading track record on profiles.

Chartroom v1: core flow = watch a serious video about a coin, then buy it in a few taps in-app. App Store within 1 month of 28 Oct 2026. Budget near zero (free tiers). Gateway partner not chosen; design against a generic gateway.

Chartroom v1 video import is Instagram only: creator connects Instagram once, then pastes links to their own reels, copied in via the official API (creator/business accounts). Other people's links rejected. YouTube import removed for now (founder, 28 Oct).

Chartroom has a News tab (own tab in the bottom bar): the team's 3-5 full articles a day (400-800 words, AI-drafted, team-verified, sources cited, affected coins with trade button). Replaces the earlier 5-10 text cards (see #54). News outlets can apply to be cited. Marketed as news + crypto + social; onboarding shows off all three.

Chartroom v3: India only. Android first (iPhone soon after; replaces iPhone-first). App in English with a casual Hinglish tone. Indian FIU-IND-registered partner (shortlist CoinDCX, CoinSwitch, Mudrex), INR/UPI, crypto tax (1% TDS, 30%) shown before every trade, ASCI warning on crypto ads. Edge over Binance Square: built for Indians. Seed with Unicorn Ka Hisab.

Founder asked for an auditor always auditing everything in Chartroom. Built by Claude: an independent auditor agent audits all work before it counts as done, logged in audit/ledger.csv. Hooks block ending a session with uncommitted files, unaudited commits or open FAILs, and block pushes until clean; non-commit work (answers, designs, research) is audited by rule with --scope. In app-kit/.claude/skills/auditor and app-kit/.claude/agents/auditor.md.

Domain skills for Chartroom in app-kit: app-social (feeds, DMs, trust and safety, scan_scams.py), app-crypto-trading (licensed partner, orders, order_math.py, per-country rules), app-news (verification pipeline, check_sources.py, corrections, news law).

Chartroom: no paid promotions in the feed; anyone can press Approve. Partner research: Mudrex Crypto-as-a-Service API (FIU-registered, KYC/custody by them, 2-4 week integration per Mudrex) first choice; CoinDCX API Broker second; on-ramp widget (Onramp.money/Onmeta) as buy-only fallback. Terms unverified until contacted.

Chartroom 'Approve' = Instagram's repost: anyone can press it; the video goes to their followers' feeds as 'Approved by @name' (creator credited) and onto an Approved tab on their profile. It replaces the old 'vouch it's accurate' meaning and a separate repost button.

Chartroom has no ads (founder doesn't want ad revenue). Instead: invest-habit reminders every 15-30 min of scrolling, can be turned off any time. Each tap adds Rs 10-20 to a habit jar, auto-invested at the partner's minimum order, into a coin or basket the user picks once. Say 'invest', never 'save'; ASCI risk warning on every reminder.
Chartroom exchange part discussed 28 Oct: affiliate links in v1, API partner later (see brief Trading section).

Chartroom v1 scope: DMs and editors' Top stories tab are in; long explainers and the verified badge move to v1.1. Reporters are told the outcome; no public safety numbers or strike counts (profiles like Instagram). News = full articles: team posts 3-5 a day (400-800 words, AI-drafted, team-verified, sources cited) and anyone can write articles too, like LinkedIn.

Chartroom 'Boring Stuff' tab: where anyone writes LinkedIn-style long articles, short text posts and image/chart posts. News tab is the team's articles only. Bottom bar: Feed, News, Boring Stuff, Trade, Profile (Post tab removed; creating starts from a + in the top bar, Claude's choice).
Chartroom: no checking of user posts (videos, Boring Stuff) before they go live at launch; too hard to start with. Only the team's own News articles are checked.

Chartroom trading v1 = affiliate links: 'Trade on <exchange>' buttons open the coin in the exchange's app; user picks their exchange once (Mudrex, CoinDCX, CoinSwitch, maybe Binance). No in-app wallet in v1. Later: Mudrex API for full wallet (buy/sell, portfolio, UPI, send out, habit jar), KYC at first trade, revenue share. Earnings disclosed once in settings/about.

Chartroom design direction v2 (founder, 28 Oct; replaces the dark saffron look, which he found too dark and AI-average): bright and bold, Instagram energy. Cobalt #2448FF for actions + hot pink #FF3D8B for social moments (like, Approve). Light and dark both designed, following the phone's setting. References: Instagram, Zerodha/Groww, Blinkit. Chunky display type (Baloo 2) + Figtree body; sticker-like chips, solid offset shadows on key buttons.
source: founder, 2026-10-28 (approved by asking for the rest)

Founder brief v0 for a new app idea: GoodHabits (social feed LinkedIn+Instagram+GitHub taste, AI news search with user trust ratings, stock/MF/FD trading via Zerodha API as the only revenue, profile with Flexes and Approved, Hissab splitwise, Good IDs, invest reminders every 15 scrolls/10 min). Verbatim in app-kit/briefs/goodhabits-founder-v0.md. Relation to Chartroom not decided yet; questions asked 29 Oct.

GoodHabits replaces Chartroom as the app we're building. Answers 29 Oct: house accounts (clearly labelled, e.g. GoodHabits Studio) seed the feed, no fake-people bots; paid creators promote GoodHabits off-platform with #ad disclosure; India only, Android first for now; v1 = all 5 tabs (Feed, News, Money Machine, Profile, Hissab).

GoodHabits details: signup's 'how much do you invest monthly' is skippable; Hissab tracks who owes what (UPI settle-up later); News = our own search index with public 1-5 trust ratings and reviews; Flexes are taken on trust (no proof); brands may post their journey and work, never 'buy now'; invest reminders are opt-in and customisable (how often).

Zerodha shares no brokerage with API apps. Only route: register as a Zerodha Authorised Person for 10% of brokerage from referred clients (NSE banned referral payouts to non-APs from 15 Aug 2024). Equity delivery and direct MFs cost Rs 0 brokerage at Zerodha, so long-term investors earn GoodHabits almost nothing. Revenue model needs a founder decision.

Zerodha Kite Connect: APIs for stock orders, GTT, holdings, live quotes; needs the user's own Zerodha account and a server backend (secret never in the app). Access token expires 6 AM daily: users log in to Kite each day. Order APIs need a whitelisted static IP since 1 Apr 2026. Mutual fund orders and new SIPs can't be placed by API. About Rs 500/month per app; Zerodha says free for startups building mass-retail products (ask them).

GoodHabits brief v1 written in app-kit/brief.md (Chartroom's brief moved to app-kit/briefs/chartroom-brief-final.md). Open: revenue model (Zerodha shares no brokerage), search engine for News (Google Custom Search closed to new customers, shuts 1 Jan 2027).

Referral back from 1 Jun 2026: 10% of brokerage referrals generate + 300 points/account; old referrals pay only if 3 new ones a year. Delivery and direct MF brokerage is Rs 0, so long-term investors earn nothing. NSE Aug 2024: referrers must be APs; ask Zerodha if an app can join.

Founder idea 29 Oct: Zerodha connect free; paid AI stock teacher Rs 500/month with demo account. Rules: education only, no buy/sell calls (that needs SEBI RA), demo on delayed or historical prices, no prizes. After GST and Play's 15% about Rs 360 net. Under review, not final.

Founder: GoodGuy AI on each company page explains why a stock moved; demo account T-1 hour. SEBI May 2024 allows education price data only with 1-day lag, no prizes, so T-1 hour isn't allowed: propose yesterday replayed. GoodGuy: past moves from cited news only, never predict or advise. Lawyer check.

Founder: GoodGuy teaches what to do in the demo. Proposed: on yesterday's replay it coaches process only (position size, stop-loss, diversification, post-trade review), never 'buy X now' (recent prices + named stock = SEBI Jan 2025 risk). In replays older than 3 months it can walk step by step.

StockGro: Indian virtual trading + AI research (Stoxo), reportedly 25-35M users, ~USD 100M raised, reportedly SEBI RA INH000018300 for advisory. Closest rival to GoodGuy + demo account. Founder believes 'no one's AI can do this'; told him it's buildable, edge must be habits and coaching.

Correction to the StockGro row: its own llms.txt (29 Oct 2026) says it is not a virtual or paper trading platform; it's SEBI RA advisory + Stoxo AI (answers buy questions). Plans shown Rs 200-550/month. Full research: app-kit/research/goodguy-2026-10-29/report.md

Founder considering presenting a complete preview to Zerodha. Rainmatter (Zerodha's investment arm) has invested ~Rs 1,500 cr in 160+ startups, ~37 fintech (Business Today, Apr 2026); no public application page found. Free Kite Connect for startups: only old forum mentions, unconfirmed.

OpenSource Everything (opensourceeverything.com): the success engine of the new age; one website hosting OpenPrep, GoodHabit beta, Community and AI Discovery Library. One sign-in: OpenID, shown as PrepID/GoodID. Long game: chat in GoodID grows into the WeChat of India; trillion-dollar ambition. Web only, no apps at start; 18+ at launch.

OpenPrep = open-source Duolingo for Indian entrance exams (CAT first) plus career and digital-marketing courses. GoodGuy mascot teaches beside a TV with card animations. Free: 10 reels + 1 long video a day, 3 practice Qs, 10 free AI mentor minutes. Paid: Rs 99 courses, Rs 100 credits, Rs 199 Pass, Rs 299 OpenPlan, Rs 100 language packs. In-house AI teachers first; teachers join later on commission.

Community: OpenID profile, connect/create GitHub repos (we handle backend), prep boards like Discord, donations UPI/Sponsors/Solana with no cut (fees+GST pass through). AI Discovery Library: trusted-source search engine mainly for AI to find us; v0 at launch. OSE preview v5 (design critique applied): one brand font (Bricolage headings, Inter body), OSE logo on phones, headline-first home with 'I'm here for' chips, 2 app tiles with illustrations, 'More from us' as plain rows, About us page with open numbers, game-style practice setup (characters, era timeline, difficulty slider, Play), single Import/₹100 button on The Good Stuff, tidier OpenPrep home.

Open Apps (rebuilt business software, e.g. Tally-style): we don't host or run them. Software is free, runs on the user's computer. Built-in AI employee = our Claude via our API, limited to our software's own tools, runs the whole app for you. Offline by default; user allows online access per domain.
